derivations.transformation: Pinned producer.skill to devforge-plan. Replaced the generic 'What changed and what remains open' section with a planning-specific readiness block: ready stories, blocked stories with their blockers, requirement coverage, dependency-graph result, unresolved decisions, new proposals kept separate from inherited requirements, and capability gaps. Added the row-shape hints for the input and output table (PROD, ARCH, EPIC, STORY). Added an explicit note in Observed verification that no DevForge command checks planning artifacts at this revision, so a graph, coverage or provenance line is this skill's own reading unless an external receipt is named. Kept the envelope verbatim in meaning, the exclude-this-handoff rule, the fixed result vocabulary, the copyable-next-task constraints and the resume and custody block including the no-self-digest rule. Removed from the shared template's 'You are here' section: the row 'Exact candidate or artifact scope: {{identity}}', because the outputs table already carries each artifact's identity and digest and a second identity row invites the two to disagree. Folded 'Task state: {{complete / partial / blocked}}' into the 'Result' row, which states the same fact in the same words. The row 'Current phase: {{phase}}' was also removed at revision 1; that removal was a defect (F-001, F-007) and the row is restored at revision 2 - see repair_pass_1.

derivations.transformation: One JSON object per line, using only grader names in that revision's GRADERS registry. Semantic expectations that no deterministic grader can establish carry grader null with a routed_to value, which the runner reports as INDETERMINATE with the routing. Two invocation groups: the PL-PKG cases take the installed package root as --candidate, and every other case takes evals/fixtures as --candidate with a candidate_subpath.
derivations.dependency_status: Repinned at repair pass 1 (F-005) from e52ac596cbf790dfa156d883852d392c512fdbcc to e641797eebf04cd1e8eb9f711549e038e7745407, the runner revision actually selected for evaluation. Still an unmerged candidate on branch author/claude-devforge-evaluate-expert-scaffold; e641797 is the derivation-digest regeneration after that package's own repair pass 1. Observed compatibility at e641797: the ten-entry GRADERS registry is byte-identical to e52ac59's; the newer runner rejects unknown case-level and assertion-level keys, and every key this file uses (case: assertions, candidate_subpath, case_id, expectations, files, mode, prompt, tier, title; assertion: args, assertion_id, expect, grader, routed_to) is inside its permitted sets; its own load_cases accepted all 18 cases of the repaired file with no duplicate case_id and no unknown grader. That recheck was performed by loading the frozen loader directly, which produces no observations file and grades nothing. If those scripts change again, recheck before any run.
